headline: Google confirms ChromeOS phase-out by 2034 for Googlebook OS
summary: Google confirmed ChromeOS support will phase out in 2034 as it transitions to a new Googlebook OS, with some existing Chromebook devices able to switch to the new system. One outlet frames the confirmation as only "seemingly" official, while others report it as a firm confirmation.

claims.statement: Google confirmed ChromeOS support will phase out in 2034 as it transitions to a new Googlebook OS.

sources.quote: Google confirmed ChromeOS updates will phase out in 2034 as the company transitions to Googlebook OS and new laptops.
Google will support ChromeOS until 2034 as it shifts to Googlebook OS

claims.statement: Some existing Chromebook devices will be able to switch to the new operating system.

sources.quote: Some recent Chromebook devices will be able to switch to the new operating system.

claims.statement: For some devices, this cuts short ChromeOS's usual 10-year support lifetime.

sources.quote: 10-year support lifetime cut short for some devices

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet frames the ChromeOS phase-out as only 'seemingly' confirmed, while others state it as a firm confirmation.
